abstract: A case of a primary retroperitoneal tumor, combining two histologic features of embryonal carcinoma and a yolk sac tumor is reported. A 31-year-old male complained of severe abdominal pain and had a laparotomy following a diagnosis of acute panperitonitis. During the operation, a large retroperitoneal tumor attached to the abdominal aorta was found, accompanied with remarkable hemorrhage and necrosis. Histologically, the tumor showed immature large cells with a solid pattern, focally forming reticular, tubular and glomeruloid structures. PAS positive hyaline bodies, multinuclear giant cells and mitoses were noted in the tumor cells. Immunohistochemically, the tumor cells in the reticular pattern were positive for alpha-fetoprotein. No abnormality was found in the testes on palpation and ultrasound sonographic examination.
abstract_ja: 胎児性癌と卵黄嚢腫瘍の2つの組織学的特徴を併せ持つ原発性後腹膜腫瘍の1例を報告する。31歳男性が激しい腹痛を訴え、急性汎腹膜炎と診断されて開腹術を受けた。手術中、腹部大動脈に付着する大きな後腹膜腫瘍が認められ、著明な出血と壊死を伴っていた。組織学的には、充実性に増殖する未熟な大型細胞からなり、網状、管状、糸球体様構造を部分的に形成していた。腫瘍細胞にはPAS陽性の硝子体小体、多核巨細胞、核分裂像が認められた。免疫組織化学では、網状パターンの腫瘍細胞がαフェトプロテイン陽性であった。精巣は触診および超音波検査で異常を認めなかった。
